description: Erection of a single storey outbuilding garden room in the rear garden.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (1/6; 2/6; 3/6; 4/6; 5/6; 6/6; TQRQM20306094243500; TQRQM20305145135520; TQRQM20305145622770  Received:  02 November 2020) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The rear outbuilding hereby approved shall be constructed with weatherboard timber cladding, grey slate composite tiles and a Swedish Redwood timber door and windows.

Condition : 5 - The rear outbuilding hereby approved shall be used only for purposes incidental to the residential use of the existing house and shall not include kitchen, bathroom or bedroom facilities, be converted to a company office, including that used by non-resident employees or visitors, or be converted to a separate self-contained dwelling.
Condition : 6 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the rear outbuilding hereby approved.
Condition : 7 - The two side windows within the rear outbuilding hereby approved shall be obscure glazed and permanently retained as such.
